LESSON: PEOPLE IN MY SCHOOL

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: My School
Topic 5.1: People in My School
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers People in My School, part of My School in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we have people in school? 2. Why do people work in school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on People in My School together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: learner enhances listening skills as they talk about people found in school.

Values:
Responsibility : learner develops sense of responsibility as they role play work done by people found in school.

42

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion: learner enhances living together in harmony as they sing songs about work done by people in the school.

Link to other learning area:

Singing songs about work done by people in the school relates to the concept of singing in creative activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Charts, flash cards, photos, working tools, huts, picture cards , braille cards, glue, crayons, realia, coloured pencil, photos, paint, cardboard,

manilla papers.
